changelog:
Personal Health Manager 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive personal health and wellness assistant.
- Features health metric tracking (blood pressure, glucose, heart rate, BMI) with detailed normal ranges.
- Provides age- and gender-specific health guidance, including screenings, nutrition, exercise, and preventive care.
- Includes medication management tools with schedules, reminders, and interaction warnings.
- Offers symptom screening with follow-up questions, self-care, and red flag alerts.
- Supports personalized recommendations based on user profile (age, gender, health status, lifestyle).
